items.name: NOOZ.AI
items.description:
NOOZ.AI Features

NOOZ.AI is an AI-powered news tool that provides the latest news sorted by the most recent updates across various categories. It features a NOOZSCORE that measures the influence level of each article, and users can filter and search for specific news stories or topics.
items.long_description:
NOOZ.AI Features

NOOZ.AI is an AI-powered news tool that provides the latest news sorted by the most recent updates across various categories. It features a NOOZSCORE that measures the influence level of each article, and users can filter and search for specific news stories or topics.

Key Features:

  1. Latest News Updates: Stay informed with the latest news across various categories.
  2. NOOZSCORE: Measure the influence level of news articles with a comprehensive scoring system.
  3. Filter and Search: Filter news stories by category or sort by influence and influence level. Use the search bar to find specific news stories or topics.
  4. Mobile App: Access news on the go with the NOOZ.AI mobile app.
  5. Social Media Integration: Connect with NOOZ.AI through popular social media platforms.
  6. Free Access: Enjoy free access to all news articles without the need for an account.

Use Cases:

  • Stay updated with the latest news in various categories.
  • Monitor the influence and credibility of news articles with the NOOZSCORE.
  • Filter and search for specific news stories or topics.
  • Access news conveniently through the NOOZ.AI mobile app.
  • Engage with NOOZ.AI and join discussions on social media.

NOOZ.AI is a valuable tool for individuals who want to stay informed and up-to-date with the latest news across different categories.
